input: Use Transylvania County and Brevard summer camp lists (Transylvania Times, Brevard tourism, local camp associations) to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: Brevard Transylvania county summer camps tourism camp association 2026

candidates.name: Camp Carolina
candidates.note: Sleepaway camp for boys in grades K–11; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with one- to four-week sessions; 2027 registration open.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Christian girls’ camp for grades 2–11; sessions range from five days to four weeks.

candidates.name: Camps Kahdalea and Chosatonga
candidates.note: Kahdalea for girls and Chosatonga for boys, mainly ages 8–17; introductory sessions accept age 7.

candidates.name: Eagle’s Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Eagle’s Nest Camp offers overnight sessions for grades K–9, including short first-time camper sessions.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Coed farm and outdoor camp, with Main Camp and older-youth adventure and leadership programs.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with riding, sports, arts, drama and climbing; operated in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–16 attend sleepaway sessions with riding, rafting, ceramics and crafts.

candidates.name: Girl Scouts Carolinas Peaks to Piedmont
candidates.note: Camp Pisgah offered summer 2026 troop camping; council summer programs serve rising grades 2–12.

candidates.name: Young Life — Carolina Point
candidates.note: Residential Christian camps for middle- and high-school students; summer 2026 attendance confirmed.

candidates.name: The Wilds Christian Association
candidates.note: The Wilds of North Carolina runs summer youth and teen camps with Bible instruction and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: Ridge Haven
candidates.note: Christian overnight youth camps; Brevard summer 2027 dates and rates published.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Coed nature-focused overnight sessions and teen expeditions; 2027 dates published.

candidates.name: YMCA Camp Greenville
candidates.note: Weeklong overnight programs with age-divided camp and adventure tracks; summer 2026 confirmed.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures serves rising grades 1–7; grades 8–12 can join its leadership program.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Residential summer music institute includes high-school programs for musicians ages 14–18.

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute
candidates.note: One- and two-week residential space-science camps for middle- and high-school students.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: Seven-week summer day-camp program for ages 4–10, plus Roots Crew counselor-in-training opportunities.

candidates.name: Bound for Glory Camp
candidates.note: Free Christian literacy and adventure camp for qualifying local youth ages 9–12; optional Friday overnights.

candidates.name: Transylvania Community Arts Council
candidates.note: Summer Arts Academy offers youth sessions in visual arts, clay, Broadway dance and video-game design.

candidates.name: Brevard Art Classes
candidates.note: Published a dedicated schedule of summer 2026 art programs.

candidates.name: Transylvania County JAM
candidates.note: Traditional Appalachian music camps at St. Philip’s Episcopal Church, including a June 15–18 morning session.

candidates.name: The Bike Farm
candidates.note: Summer mountain-bike camps for ages 8–14 with prior riding experience; summer 2026 dates confirmed.

candidates.name: Transylvania Youth Soccer Association
candidates.note: Ecusta FC youth soccer skills camp ran July 20–24, 2026.

candidates.name: Southland Student Camps
candidates.note: High-school Christian camp at Ridge Haven announced for June 7–12, 2027.
